nodes.name: Build error alert
nodes.notes: Why Code: writes the alert from an en/es message table and never throws on an unvalidated config

parameters.subject: ={{ $json.subject ?? '[Nubandina demo] Workflow failed: ' + ($('On workflow error').first().json.workflow?.name ?? 'unknown') }}
parameters.message: ={{ $json.text ?? 'The alert could not be built in the team language. Error: ' + ($('On workflow error').first().json.execution?.error?.message ?? $('On workflow error').first().json.trigger?.error?.message ?? 'unknown') }}

parameters.content:
## Error handler
Runs when a workflow naming this one as its errorWorkflow fails, including a trigger failing at startup (only trigger.error, no execution data). Loads config, then emails the owner a plain-text alert in team_locale: the failed node, the error, the execution URL, and the time in Bogota. The config is unvalidated here, so a bad team_locale falls back to English. It has no errorWorkflow of its own, so a failure here can't loop.
